name: CourtesyCallback
description: Courtesy Callback Flow (Used for All Queues)

variables.name: QueueID
variables.description: Queue ID from the original queue

variables.name: OriginalQueue
variables.description: Holds the original queue name so we can send back to that EP if the caller is sent back

variables.name: ReturnedFromCallback
variables.description: Track whether the caller failed out of the callback flow & returned to the original queue

variables.name: Global_VoiceName
variables.description: System-defined variable to store the voice name

variables.name: Global_Language
variables.description: System-defined variable to store the language

variables.name: Global_FeedbackSurveyOptIn
variables.description: System-defined variable that indicates if the caller opts in to complete a feedback survey

properties.name: StripE164to10Digits
properties.description: Strip the "+1" to make this a 10-digit number

properties.name: CollectCallbackNumber
properties.description: Prompt caller to enter a callback number

properties.name: ConfirmCallbackNumber
properties.description: Read entered callback number back to caller to confirm
properties.connector:name: Cisco Cloud Text-to-Speech

properties.name: CheckOriginalQ1
properties.description: Check original queue so we can send it back to the correct EP

properties.name: CheckOriginalQ2
properties.description: Check original queue so we can send it back to the correct EP

properties.name: GoToClosedBlockPayments
properties.description: Go to Closed Block Payments EP (queue)

properties.name: GoToFHPrecoaClaims
properties.description: Go to Funeral Home Precoa Claims EP (queue)
